Following last month’s launch of the iPhone Duo, which also saw the release of Apple’s official repair manuals for the device, Apple today began selling replacement parts and tools through its Self Service Repair Store. Here are the details.

Apple now selling iPhone Duo repair parts

Since 2022, Apple has offered its Self Service Repair program, allowing users in eligible regions to purchase replacement parts and buy or rent the tools needed to perform their own repairs on supported devices.

Just a few weeks ago, Apple began offering replacement parts and tools for several recently released devices, including the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, the latest Mac Studio, and the Mac mini.

Today, the company also added the iPhone Duo to the list, allowing owners and independent repair technicians to purchase the necessary replacement parts to perform repairs on the device themselves.

Apple’s available replacement parts for the iPhone Duo include:

  • Back Glass
  • Both batteries
  • Bottom Speaker
  • Camera
  • Cover layer
  • Enclosure
  • FaceTime Camera
  • Inner Displav
  • Inner Display Assembly
  • Input/Output Board
  • Logic Board
  • Main Microphone
  • Outer Display
  • Outer Front Camera
  • Taptic Engine
  • Top Speaker
  • TouchID and Camera Control
  • USB-C Connector
  • Volume Buttons

In addition to these and other replacement parts, Apple also offers the tools and other supplies needed for each repair procedure. These include adhesive cutters, suction cups, nylon probes, adhesive removal tools, torque drivers, and screws, all of which can also be purchased separately.

For users looking for guidance on performing these repairs, Apple also offers detailed, step-by-step repair manuals, which the company released on the same day the iPhone Duo launched last month. These include instructions for replacing components such as the inner and outer displays, batteries, cameras, and logic board.
